title: Replacement of a current carried by the n-skeleton by an integer polyhedral chain from a finite family (proof of Simon 6.5.1, (26)–(37), and 6.7.2 (1)–(3))
statement: Assume, as hypotheses of the statement, (VO) the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (MR) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open and an IMRep R representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W; (IMC) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces for Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ (K ⊆ U compact); (b) the restriction (M ∩ E, θ, ξ) of an IMRep to a Borel E is an IMRep representing some current; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity for integer multiplicity A, B (U open); (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier. (These are the exact frozen Lean types of the accepted declarations named above, written as antecedents. The parent node discharges them with Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support, with its dependency Submission.dtc_mass_eq_measure, from which the type of cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure follows by replacing W with W ∩ U, and with its dependency Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub.) For all P, m ∈ ℕ (n := m + 1) there is c ∈ ℝ≥0 with c ≥ 1 such that for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P and every Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 there is a finite set 𝒬₀ of currents in 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (domain univ) with the following property: if Q₀ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) is integer multiplicity, spt Q₀ ⊆ K, spt Q₀ ⊆ L_n := {x : there is a set s of coordinate indices with P ≤ n + |s| and x_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ s}, M(Q₀) ≤ Λ and M(∂Q₀) < ∞, then there is Pc ∈ 𝒬₀ such that Pc and ∂Pc are integer multiplicity, Pc = 0 or M(Pc) ≥ 1, M(Pc) ≤ cM(Q₀), M(∂Pc) ≤ cM(∂Q₀), M(Q₀ − Pc) ≤ cM(∂Q₀), spt Pc ⊆ cthickening(√P, spt Q₀) and spt(Q₀ − Pc) ∪ spt ∂Pc ⊆ cthickening(√P, spt ∂Q₀).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : NNReal, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal), IsCompact K → ∃ 𝒬₀ : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬₀.Finite ∧ ∀ Q₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q₀ → Q₀.support ⊆ K → Q₀.support ⊆ {x : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z} → Q₀.mass ≤ Λ → Q₀.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ Pc ∈ 𝒬₀, IsIntegerMultiplicity Pc ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Pc.boundary ∧ (Pc = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ Pc.mass) ∧ Pc.mass ≤ c * Q₀.mass ∧ Pc.boundary.mass ≤ c * Q₀.boundary.mass ∧ (Q₀ - Pc).mass ≤ c * Q₀.boundary.mass ∧ Pc.support ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt P) Q₀.support ∧ (Q₀ - Pc).support ∪ Pc.boundary.support ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt P) Q₀.boundary.support
